title: CY60117: Reagents In Organic Synthesis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : NilOrganosilicon, organotin, organoborane reagents;
organocopper, organopalladium and functionalized Grignard reagents;
oragnocatalysts; metal carbonyl reagents; Lewis Acids in organic synthesis.
Books: Some Modern methods of Organic Synthesis by W. Carruthers, 2004;
Advanced Organic Chemistry Pt B: Reaction and Synthesis by F. A. Carey and R.
J. Sundberg, 2001.
